hint_decisions.exact_candidate_guidance_wording: Ask the local referral/navigation and scheduling stewards how recognition, referral issuance, appointment creation, planned occurrence and completed encounters are recorded. If FHIR R4 4.0.1 is available locally, ServiceRequest, Appointment and Encounter may describe some order, scheduling and encounter milestones. Order activation is not recognition; appointment creation is not booking acceptance; a planned appointment is not a completed encounter. Confirm local definitions, optional links, missingness, history and vendor support. Request only aggregate or de-identified interval summaries and episode counts within the current planning horizon, with locally approved small-cell handling. Keep identifiable records and raw dates with the steward. These summaries do not establish intervention effects.
required_conditions: Local system/element/version/terminology and operational definitions confirmed; do not imply FHIR certification
Local data steward approves only minimum-necessary aggregate release, with rare-cell/differencing suppression as needed
Unknown/stale/mismatched artifact, pathway, family, template/request fingerprint, registry, source or review identity must withhold optional guidance
No raw patient/staff records or dates, no API access, no automatic Brief inclusion
hint_decisions.additional_note: Timing milestones remain distinct; no causal effects

hint_decisions.exact_candidate_guidance_wording: Ask program operations and scheduling stewards for aggregate staffed usable capacity and available appointment or navigation slots by site/service and week or month within the current planning horizon. If FHIR R4 4.0.1 is available locally, Slot and Schedule may describe scheduling intervals and resource availability. Free slots are not staffed capacity, FTE, unique participants, catchment or wait-time metrics. Confirm staffing, workload units, shared resources, reserve blocks, overbooking, service coverage and vendor support locally; use an aggregate HR/roster summary only if FTE is needed. Exclude patient and employee identities and apply local small-cell review. No resource guarantees these program metrics or their availability.

risks_requiring_review: The word de-identified is not a universal disclosure-safe standard; require locally approved aggregate intervals/counts and ensure no individual-level interval records leave the steward.
Local vendors/profiles/history/linkage may not provide any cited resource.
The exact request fingerprint, stale registry/policy IDs and direct-constructor/export checks exist only as proposed semantics until independently implemented and tested.
